comments.author: DeePix

Done in v1.1.0!

I added a config/config.json file, so you can now customize the case size, internal grid size, price, trader, loyalty level, accepted categories and accepted items.

Thanks a lot for the suggestion, it helped me improve the mod in a useful direction.
